title: nf-core/macproqc pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

spectrum_file.errorMessage: MS file name, cannot contain spaces and must have one of the extensions: raw | RAW | mzML | d (or compressed version)

base_peak_tic_up_to.description: Retrieve the base peak intensity maximum and the total ion current from minute 0 up to this number of minutes. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

filter_threshold.description: Threshold, relative to the highest overall MS1 peak, below which MS1 peaks are disregarded. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

report_up_to_charge.description: Upper limit of the precursor charge range to be reported. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

ms1_map_rt_bins.description: Number of retention time grid cells of the MS1 ion map. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

ms1_map_mz_bins.description: Number of m/z grid cells of the MS1 ion map. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

bruker_headers_to_parse.description: Bruker global headers to parse (Bruker runs only). Comma-separated; added to the macproqc_helpers defaults. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

bruker_frame_headers_to_parse.description: Bruker frame headers to parse (Bruker runs only). Comma-separated; added to the macproqc_helpers defaults. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

bruker_calibrants.description: Bruker calibrants as MZ:Mobility (Bruker runs only). Comma-separated; added to the macproqc_helpers defaults. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

bruker_calibrants_mz_tolerance.description: m/z tolerance of the Bruker calibrants in Th. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

bruker_calibrants_mobility_tolerance.description: Mobility tolerance of the Bruker calibrants in 1/K0. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

thermo_extra_headers_to_parse.description: Thermo extra (scan) headers to parse (Thermo runs only). Comma-separated; added to the macproqc_helpers defaults. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

thermo_tune_headers_to_parse.description: Thermo tune headers to parse (Thermo runs only). Comma-separated; added to the macproqc_helpers defaults. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

thermo_log_headers_to_parse.description: Thermo status log headers to parse (Thermo runs only). Comma-separated; added to the macproqc_helpers defaults. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

hdf5_put_under_subdataset.description: Put the data under a subdataset in the combined HDF5 file. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.

hdf5_write_metadata.description: Write the 'METADATA' node to the combined HDF5 file. Falls back to the pipeline parameter of the same name if empty.
